# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.99

Backoffice now shares the existing archive policy, schedule, numbered dated downloads, Active/Archived/All views and storage counts. Archived errors are labeled read-only. Error resolution refreshes the modification timestamp and reports actual affected counts, so a newly resolved old error remains active for its recent-history window. Permanent purge remains separate from routine archiving.

Older delivery-log JSON and CSV snapshot files can be compressed and SHA256/decompression-verified while retaining original-content downloads and carbon-copy delivery printing. Each run handles up to 10 eligible files; creation/modification cutoffs protect recent files. Initial file windows are 30 days. Existing saved policies keep the two new file sections disabled until explicitly enabled. CSV review snapshots are no longer automatically deleted. Database backups and paired rollback retention are unchanged.

RX Profile Sync defaults **off**. A persisted Stop / leave off control blocks routine scans and single/bulk copying. Enabling requires a starting date, inclusive from **00:00 UTC using RX creation time**. Older RX records are excluded; patient multi-RX counts remain complete across the cutoff. Explicit review while paused and individual/bulk Mark reviewed / ignore actions record review decisions without changing patient/RX values or RX change history. Reviewed comparisons leave Pending and can be reopened; later value changes can require new review. No automatic copying is introduced.

Raw table browsing filters, sorts and pages on the server. Complete table exports use bounded keyset requests. CSV snapshots use a read-only repeatable-read cursor fetching 250 rows at a time and include archive base tables. Full snapshots still read the complete database; same-database archiving does not reduce total database storage.

## Installation

Verify SHA256SUMS.txt and LOCAL_VALIDATION.json. Install through Project Control **option 8 then 15**, preserving .env, configured RX Actions and the paired application/database rollback set. No new migration since next.98 (65 migrations total), installation-time patient/RX rewrite or automatic file compression is introduced. If upgrading from before next.98, its archive migration still applies through the guarded updater. Require healthy version 4.0.0-next.99, inspect archive settings and verify RX Profile Sync is off unless intentionally enabled. Publication does not install production.

## File backup and recovery

Protect the complete delivery and CSV snapshot directories, including gzip files, .gz.sha256 receipts, delivery sequence ledger and renderer dependencies. Sensitive runtime archives are excluded from general site packages. Older application binaries cannot read compressed files: retain a compatible application or perform explicitly verified filesystem rehydration during recovery. Paired application/database rollback alone does not restore external archive files. See packaged docs/HISTORY_ARCHIVING.md and docs/RX_PROFILE_SYNC_CONTROLS.md before enabling file compression.

## Validation

Built, tested and packaged locally for the source commit recorded in LOCAL_VALIDATION.json. The required lifecycle suite includes archive retention, actual PostgreSQL CSV cursors, paused sync APIs, inclusive cutoff, reviewed/ignore immutability, backup/restore, sanitized copies and restricted runtime checks. Both executables retain verified Node.js 22.23.4. Existing source findings, moderate Sequelize/UUID advisories and unchanged Softphone dependency warnings remain documented; this release does not claim to resolve them.
